query: UPDATE factory.ticket_attempts SET stage = $1::SMALLINT, rework_ordinal = rework_ordinal + $2, failed_at = CASE WHEN $1::SMALLINT = $3::SMALLINT THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE failed_at END, failure_reason = CASE WHEN $1::SMALLINT = $3::SMALLINT THEN 'architect rejected reviewed candidate' ELSE failure_reason END, revision = $4 WHERE id = $5
